header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar, advocate for respondent Nos.3 to 6
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. Respondent Nos.3 to
body: 6 files comments, which are taken on record.

The perusal of the record shows that this petition was filed in the year 2023 and was lastly fixed on 07.11.2023 where the notices were issued to the respondents and learned D.A.G. Thereafter, no efforts were made by the petitioner to pursue this petition, which reflects that he is not interested in the same.
Under these circumstances, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
